outcome: prolonged hospitalization (> 48 h) for postpartum endometritis
cohort: The study included 270 women with postpartum endometritis who were readmitted for intravenous antibiotic treatment between 2014 and 2022.
finding: A predictive scoring system was developed that identified rupture of membranes > 14.5 h, temperature > 37.25 degC at readmission, and CRP > 6.5 mg/dL at readmission as independent factors associated with prolonged hospitalization (> 48 h) in postpartum endometritis.
